subject: Mutual action: Lumina eval asset exchange & close timeline
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Linda Park <linda@luminalabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action: Lumina eval asset exchange & close timeline

Hi Linda —

Thanks again for the workshop this morning. Per our conversation, I put together an initial mutual action plan (attached) that outlines a short onramp for the evaluation assets (prompt packs, testcases, and the sample dataset) plus clear usage constraints and a takedown timeline. High-level ask: if Lumina is comfortable with the terms below we can lock dates and kick off ingestion/QA next week.

Proposed milestones (draft):
- Week 0 (June 21): Lumina delivers sample_manifest.csv and encrypted archive (S3 presigned link).
- Week 1–2 (June 22–July 5): Redwood staging + validation; access limited to Redwood evaluation cluster (ephemeral sandbox).
- Week 3 (by July 12): Acceptance gate — Lumina runs acceptance tests; minor regression window.
- Week 6 (by Aug 2): Evaluation close; Redwood returns or destroys assets per the MPA; ephemeral access revoked.

Usage constraints (short):
- Temporary, non-exclusive loan for evaluation only; no training or model improvement unless explicitly agreed and dual-anonymized.
- Token/sample usage caps per the manifest (see section 4).
- Sample retention capped to the evaluation window above; destruction certificate provided on takedown.

I included a first-pass MPA (Redwood_MPA_Draft_v1.pdf) with editable sections for your legal team. If these high-level dates look reasonable, can you confirm by end of day Monday (6/14)? If you want a shorter acceptance window I can surface that to the ops team for feasibility.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action: Lumina eval asset exchange & close timeline

Hi Priya —

Thanks — this is really helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side before we loop Legal:
1) Retention: can the retention window be reduced to 4 weeks after acceptance instead of 6? We want a firm destruction window.
2) Model improvement: Lumina's policy is strict — we will not permit any usage for training or model tuning. Is Redwood able to commit to a no-derivative-use clause (even on anonymized subsets)?
3) Sandbox location: We require that the evaluation run in a US-only sandbox; can Redwood confirm region constraints and SOC2 evidence for the evaluation cluster?

If you can confirm the above and provide a quick redlineable MPA we can have Legal send over two small edits. CC'd Marissa for any ingestion notes.

Best,
Linda
Linda Park
Head of Integrations, Lumina Labs
linda@luminalabs.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Linda Park <linda@luminalabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action: Lumina eval asset exchange & close timeline

Hi Linda — thanks; answers inline below.

1) Retention: We can accommodate a 4-week post-acceptance retention and provide a signed destruction certificate (section 6 updated).

2) Model improvement: Understood and agreed — we will add a no-derivative-use clause forbidding training/fine-tuning on the materials. The MPA has an optional clause for aggregated telemetry only (opt-out) — we will remove that for this engagement unless you opt in.

3) Sandbox region & compliance: Confirmed — evaluation will run in our US-only evaluation cluster; SOC 2 Type II report excerpt and environment diagram are attached as part of our security appendix. Ops note: Karthik is the ingestion lead and will coordinate the S3 key rotation/temporary credentials. Marissa will own the acceptance checklist (ingest/QA).

I've attached Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf with the retention and no-derivative clauses updated and a sample_manifest template. If Lumina's legal can send redlines we'll review and respond quickly. Also included a tentative DocuSign link to speed signature once redlines are finalized.

Proposed revised schedule (shortened retention / tightened acceptance):
- Deliverables: June 21
- Staging/validation: June 22–July 3
- Acceptance window: July 6 (test run) — July 10 (final acceptance)
- Destruction: Aug 7 (4 weeks after acceptance)

Ping me directly if you want to shorten the acceptance window further — happy to trade additional validation support for a tighter cut.

Thanks —
Priya

Hi Priya / Marissa —

Attached are Lumina Legal's redlines (summary below). We appreciate the flexibility on retention and the no-derivative clause. Two items we flagged:

- Acceptance window: Can we move the acceptance gate up so final acceptance is July 8 instead of July 10? That helps our internal release calendar.
- Escrow / destruction proof: we asked for a second-party audit step for destruction — can Redwood provide a checksum-backed deletion report?

See attached PDF (Lumina_Redlines_0616.pdf). If those two items can be accommodated we should be able to sign quickly.

Thanks,

Subject: RE: Mutual action: Lumina eval asset exchange & close timeline — agreed next steps

Linda / Ethan —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the redlines. We reviewed internally and can accept both asks: final acceptance moved to July 8 and we will provide a checksum-backed deletion report as part of the takedown certificate.

Finalized milestones (agreed):
- Asset delivery: Tue, 2027-06-21 — Lumina uploads encrypted archive + sample_manifest.csv to provided S3 bucket.
- Staging & validation: 2027-06-22 through 2027-07-01 (Redwood ops).
- Acceptance run: 2027-07-06 to 2027-07-08 (Lumina performs acceptance tests; minor issues resolved by Redwood within 48h).
- Final acceptance signed: 2027-07-08 (mutual sign-off via shared acceptance doc).
- Destruction & certificate: on or before 2027-08-05 (checksum-backed deletion report provided).

Next steps:
1) Marissa will share the ingestion checklist and small pre-ingest validation script (two files) by EOD Monday 6/20.
2) Karthik will send temporary S3 credentials and key-rotation plan on 6/20.
3) Once Lumina confirms the redlined MPA, we'll send the DocuSign envelope (link below) and target signature by 6/24 so ingestion can start 6/21 as planned.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/REDWOOD-LUMINA-MPA-2027
Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Lumina-MPA-2027

I'll attach the signed MPA here after signatures are complete. Looking forward to getting started — we will treat the materials as strictly evaluation-only.

—Priya
